title: Fake artists ruined my Spotify until I found two tools to expose them all
excerpt: Some of those bands don't really exist
content_html:
Published Jul 31, 2026, 7:30 AM EDT

Rita is a Senior Writer at Android Police. Her love story with Android started in 2010 and has been going stronger with every update, device, tip, app, and game. She's a huge Pixel fan and has spent an inordinate amount of time using and testing Google's ecosystem, apps, and services.

She lives in France, speaks more than three languages, follows Real Madrid, and spends any free time she has traveling. Once upon a time, she was a pharmacist as well.

I've been a Spotify user since 2008, first as a free listener, then as a Premium subscriber. Spotify's excellent features have helped me discover many artists and bands that I fell in love with, but in recent times, it's become an AI-infested bin.

The first time I fell for an AI artist, I couldn't believe it. It seemed too good and indistinguishable from a real artist's music to my non-professional ears. If AI still fails to make convincing images, how could it possibly be good enough at music to fool me?

Oh, how wrong I was. Soon, I discovered that because I'd listened to that one artist, many of my recommendations were similarly AI-generated. My Spotify was ruined. That's when I decided to do something about it and stop it.

Fake artists are everywhere on Spotify

You just have to pay attention

About 90% of my music listening on Spotify is centered around my own playlists or those created by people I trust. But every once in a while, I use the radio or Spotify-generated mix playlists, and end up on the algorithm's side of music streaming.

That's where things started going wrong. One day, I was playing music while working and enjoying it without actively focusing on it. Soon, an "artist" name popped up enough times that I stopped to check them out — "Apukat." Every song was exactly up to my taste.

Their metalcore, symphonic and modern arena rock vibe was such a perfect fit with the music I enjoy as a fan of Linkin Park, Muse, Apocalyptica, Nightwish, Within Temptation, etc. That should've been my first warning sign, the formulaic-ness of it.

It took me a while to feel sketchy about this music. By then, my Spotify had been overtaken by more AI artists. Beyond Apukat, my two biggest heartbreaks are Glum Aleks and Ministry of Dark. Their music was so up to my speed. Some of the others are listed below:

  • Bleeding Verse
  • Ghost//Signal
  • Deathly Hours
  • Exiles of Eden
  • Shadows Awake
  • The Devil Inside
  • Obsidian Swing
  • Aventhis
  • The Velvet Sundown
  • Beyond Disdain
  • King Vagabond
  • Hexxenmind
  • Lyryxx
  • Soul's Cry
  • Breaking Rust

And this is just what I've run into in a few specific genres. I imagine there are more AI-generated artists and bands doing pop, country, folk, rap, R&B, EDM, country, or any and all genres of music. It couldn't just be prevalent in rock and Nordic metal.

Actually, let's rephrase this. I didn't run into this music, Spotify recommended it to me through its radio, Discover Weekly, Daily Mixes, and other artist and genre mix playlists. It pushed that music to me, without a single warning that it's all AI-generated.

A few signs that the music you're listening to is AI-generated

Listen carefully or open your eyes

As I mentioned earlier, some of the signs of AI-generated music are in the music itself:

  1. Singing tones, accents, and timbres shift between songs.
  2. You may find the same vocal artist singing with different "bands."
  3. Lyrics are generic, lean into the genre's trope, and don't say anything too personal or too unexpected. They're the lowest common denominator you can think of.
  4. Mixing sounds over-polished or full of artifacts, especially the instrumentation.
  5. The music is too formulaic, too much of a good fit for the genre.

If, however, like me, you're not that good at detecting musical queues, there are other signs to pay attention to that any internet-savvy person should be able to detect:

  1. There's no artist or band photo, just a generic and clearly AI-generated artist image.
  2. All album and single covers follow the same pattern, too.
  3. The Spotify bio is very vague and doesn't mention any person's name. Most of them use the word "project."
  4. Song credits are very bare bones and don't list any real composers, producers, lyricists, instrument players, etc.
  5. They've started publishing music in 2025 and are very prolific with multiple EPs and albums in the span of a year.
  6. Their YouTube presence is full of AI-generated videos or lyrics videos.
  7. They don't have any social media presence, and no upcoming tour or any presence on concert-tracking sites like Songkick or Bandsintown.

The two tools I use to weed out AI artists from my Spotify

There's no single toggle, you have to do the work

There isn't one easy way to tell Spotify you don't want to listen to AI music. Instead, the onus is on you, the user, to figure out whether what's being recommended to you is made by real artists or an AI platform like Suno or Udio.

Of course, you can do your own sleuthing, check Reddit to see what other people think, look up comments on YouTube, but I found two faster ways to do this.

The first one is a website called Sloptracker (screenshots above), a site made by a real musician who wants to raise awareness around the impact of AI-generated slop on real artists' income.

Sloptracker has an AI scanner that analyzes the frequency spectrum and timing patterns of any song (Spotify URL or MP3 file) to predict with 99% accuracy whether it was completely AI-generated, completely human-made, or processed by AI.

In my experience, it works really well and helped me verify that the artists I listed above triggered its red flags, too. It also lists the top detected AI artists, so you can have a quick scroll through them and see if any of them ring a bell.

Breaking Rust, for example, is estimated to have made $297,571 so far and be draining over 2,000 Premium subscriptions every month. That's money that could've gone to human artists if those subscribers had spent their time listening to human-made music.

The second tool I've found is Deezer's AI Music Detector, which can scan your entire music library from multiple services (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Tidal, etc.) and tell you what it flags.

But the import and scan tool kept failing for me, so I found a Chrome extension that uses Deezer's built-in AI labeling to scan my playlists one by one. It's called DigiMuziek AI Spotter, and it only works if you're using Spotify's website, not the Windows or Mac app.

But it does exactly what I need it to do: quickly scan a playlist, tell me which artists it flags, let me instantly block them without going through them one by one on Spotify, and even auto-skip AI songs when playing music.

I can't tell you how many questionable recommendations I found in some of my playlists thanks to it. I easily weeded them out of my library.

However, pay attention to the fact that both of these tools are not foolproof. They flagged some very real artists like HOKKA and Blas Canto as AI-generated. I've seen both of them sing live (Joel Hokka was a member of Blind Channel).

It's like playing whack-a-mole

I've spent the past few weeks trying to remove as many AI artists and AI-generated music from my Spotify playlists and recommendations. The best way is to immediately tap Don't play this artist on any sketchy artist or band I spot.

But they keep popping up, more of them, all the time. Spotify has said it's working on labeling AI music, but artists will have to declare it themselves (ha!) and there's no toggle in the works to opt out of AI music by default. That sucks.

Studies show that most people can't detect AI-generated music and that more than 28% of new music being published on Spotify is AI-generated or edited. It's a lucrative business that doesn't require much effort, so why would anyone stop doing it?

Personally, I'd much rather my Premium money go to real artists, and until there's an easier way to do it, I'll continue fighting to fix my algorithm to only show me human-made music.

sentences.zh: 您可能会发现同一位声乐艺术家与不同的“乐队”一起演唱。

blocks.html_en: • Lyrics are generic, lean into the genre's trope, and don't say anything too personal or too unexpected. They're the lowest common denominator you can think of.

sentences.en: Lyrics are generic, lean into the genre's trope, and don't say anything too personal or too unexpected.
sentences.zh: 歌词是通用的，倾向于该流派的比喻，并且不要说任何太个人化或太出乎意料的内容。

sentences.en: They're the lowest common denominator you can think of.
sentences.zh: 它们是您能想到的最低公分母。

blocks.html_en: • Mixing sounds over-polished or full of artifacts, especially the instrumentation.

sentences.en: Mixing sounds over-polished or full of artifacts, especially the instrumentation.
sentences.zh: 混音声音过于精致或充满伪影，尤其是乐器。

blocks.html_en: • The music is too formulaic, too much of a good fit for the genre.

sentences.en: The music is too formulaic, too much of a good fit for the genre.
sentences.zh: 音乐太公式化，太适合这种类型。

blocks.html_en: If, however, like me, you're not that good at detecting musical queues, there are other signs to pay attention to that any internet-savvy person should be able to detect:

sentences.en: If, however, like me, you're not that good at detecting musical queues, there are other signs to pay attention to that any internet-savvy person should be able to detect:
sentences.zh: 但是，如果您像我一样不擅长检测音乐队列，那么还有其他迹象需要注意，任何精通互联网的人都应该能够检测到：

blocks.html_en: • There's no artist or band photo, just a generic and clearly AI-generated artist image.

sentences.en: There's no artist or band photo, just a generic and clearly AI-generated artist image.
sentences.zh: 没有艺术家或乐队的照片，只有人工智能生成的通用且清晰的艺术家图像。

blocks.html_en: • All album and single covers follow the same pattern, too.

sentences.en: All album and single covers follow the same pattern, too.
sentences.zh: 所有专辑和单曲封面也遵循相同的模式。

blocks.html_en: • The Spotify bio is very vague and doesn't mention any person's name. Most of them use the word "project."

sentences.en: The Spotify bio is very vague and doesn't mention any person's name.
sentences.zh: Spotify 的简介非常模糊，没有提及任何人的名字。

sentences.en: Most of them use the word "project."
sentences.zh: 他们中的大多数人都使用“项目”这个词。

blocks.html_en: • Song credits are very bare bones and don't list any real composers, producers, lyricists, instrument players, etc.

sentences.en: Song credits are very bare bones and don't list any real composers, producers, lyricists, instrument players, etc.
sentences.zh: 歌曲的制作人员名单非常简单，没有列出任何真正的作曲家、制作人、作词家、乐器演奏者等。

blocks.html_en: • They've started publishing music in 2025 and are very prolific with multiple EPs and albums in the span of a year.

sentences.en: They've started publishing music in 2025 and are very prolific with multiple EPs and albums in the span of a year.
sentences.zh: 他们于 2025 年开始出版音乐，一年内就推出了多张 EP 和专辑，非常多产。

blocks.html_en: • Their YouTube presence is full of AI-generated videos or lyrics videos.

sentences.en: Their YouTube presence is full of AI-generated videos or lyrics videos.
sentences.zh: 他们的 YouTube 上充满了人工智能生成的视频或歌词视频。

blocks.html_en: • They don't have any social media presence, and no upcoming tour or any presence on concert-tracking sites like Songkick or Bandsintown.

sentences.en: They don't have any social media presence, and no upcoming tour or any presence on concert-tracking sites like Songkick or Bandsintown.
sentences.zh: 他们没有任何社交媒体，也没有即将举行的巡演，也没有出现在 Songkick 或 Bandsintown 等音乐会跟踪网站上。

blocks.html_en: The two tools I use to weed out AI artists from my Spotify

sentences.en: The two tools I use to weed out AI artists from my Spotify
sentences.zh: 我用来从 Spotify 中剔除人工智能艺术家的两个工具

blocks.html_en: There's no single toggle, you have to do the work

sentences.en: There's no single toggle, you have to do the work
sentences.zh: 没有单一的切换，你必须完成工作

blocks.html_en: There isn't one easy way to tell Spotify you don't want to listen to AI music. Instead, the onus is on you, the user, to figure out whether what's being recommended to you is made by real artists or an AI platform like Suno or Udio.

sentences.en: There isn't one easy way to tell Spotify you don't want to listen to AI music.
sentences.zh: 没有一种简单的方法可以告诉 Spotify 你不想听 AI 音乐。

sentences.en: Instead, the onus is on you, the user, to figure out whether what's being recommended to you is made by real artists or an AI platform like Suno or Udio.
sentences.zh: 相反，作为用户的你有责任弄清楚向你推荐的内容是由真正的艺术家还是由 Suno 或 Udio 等人工智能平台制作的。

blocks.html_en: Of course, you can do your own sleuthing, check Reddit to see what other people think, look up comments on YouTube, but I found two faster ways to do this.

sentences.en: Of course, you can do your own sleuthing, check Reddit to see what other people think, look up comments on YouTube, but I found two faster ways to do this.
sentences.zh: 当然，你可以自己进行调查，查看 Reddit 看看其他人的想法，查找 YouTube 上的评论，但我发现了两种更快的方法来做到这一点。

blocks.html_en: The first one is a website called Sloptracker (screenshots above), a site made by a real musician who wants to raise awareness around the impact of AI-generated slop on real artists' income.

sentences.en: The first one is a website called Sloptracker (screenshots above), a site made by a real musician who wants to raise awareness around the impact of AI-generated slop on real artists' income.
sentences.zh: 第一个是一个名为 Sloptracker 的网站（上面的屏幕截图），该网站由一位真正的音乐家创建，他希望提高人们对人工智能生成的 slop 对真正艺术家收入的影响的认识。

blocks.html_en: Sloptracker has an AI scanner that analyzes the frequency spectrum and timing patterns of any song (Spotify URL or MP3 file) to predict with 99% accuracy whether it was completely AI-generated, completely human-made, or processed by AI.

sentences.en: Sloptracker has an AI scanner that analyzes the frequency spectrum and timing patterns of any song (Spotify URL or MP3 file) to predict with 99% accuracy whether it was completely AI-generated, completely human-made, or processed by AI.
sentences.zh: Sloptracker 拥有一个 AI 扫描仪，可以分析任何歌曲（Spotify URL 或 MP3 文件）的频谱和时序模式，以 99% 的准确度预测它是完全由 AI 生成、完全人造还是由 AI 处理。

blocks.html_en: In my experience, it works really well and helped me verify that the artists I listed above triggered its red flags, too. It also lists the top detected AI artists, so you can have a quick scroll through them and see if any of them ring a bell.

sentences.en: In my experience, it works really well and helped me verify that the artists I listed above triggered its red flags, too.
sentences.zh: 根据我的经验，它的效果非常好，并帮助我验证了上面列出的艺术家是否也触发了危险信号。

sentences.en: It also lists the top detected AI artists, so you can have a quick scroll through them and see if any of them ring a bell.
sentences.zh: 它还列出了检测到的最热门的 AI 艺术家，因此您可以快速滚动浏览他们，看看是否有任何人引起您的注意。

blocks.html_en: Breaking Rust, for example, is estimated to have made $297,571 so far and be draining over 2,000 Premium subscriptions every month. That's money that could've gone to human artists if those subscribers had spent their time listening to human-made music.

sentences.en: Breaking Rust, for example, is estimated to have made $297,571 so far and be draining over 2,000 Premium subscriptions every month.
sentences.zh: 例如，《Breaking Rust》迄今为止预计收入为 297,571 美元，每月有超过 2,000 名高级订阅用户流失。

sentences.en: That's money that could've gone to human artists if those subscribers had spent their time listening to human-made music.
sentences.zh: 如果这些订阅者花时间听人造音乐，那么这笔钱本来可以流向人类艺术家。

blocks.html_en: The second tool I've found is Deezer's AI Music Detector, which can scan your entire music library from multiple services (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Tidal, etc.) and tell you what it flags.

sentences.en: The second tool I've found is Deezer's AI Music Detector, which can scan your entire music library from multiple services (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Tidal, etc.) and tell you what it flags.
sentences.zh: 我发现的第二个工具是 Deezer 的 AI 音乐检测器，它可以从多个服务（Spotify、Apple Music、YouTube Music、SoundCloud、Tidal 等）扫描您的整个音乐库，并告诉您它标记的内容。

blocks.html_en: But the import and scan tool kept failing for me, so I found a Chrome extension that uses Deezer's built-in AI labeling to scan my playlists one by one. It's called DigiMuziek AI Spotter, and it only works if you're using Spotify's website, not the Windows or Mac app.

sentences.en: But the import and scan tool kept failing for me, so I found a Chrome extension that uses Deezer's built-in AI labeling to scan my playlists one by one.
sentences.zh: 但导入和扫描工具对我来说一直失败，所以我找到了一个 Chrome 扩展程序，它使用 Deezer 的内置 AI 标签来逐个扫描我的播放列表。

sentences.en: It's called DigiMuziek AI Spotter, and it only works if you're using Spotify's website, not the Windows or Mac app.
sentences.zh: 它被称为 DigiMuziek AI Spotter，只有在您使用 Spotify 网站而不是 Windows 或 Mac 应用程序时才有效。

blocks.html_en: But it does exactly what I need it to do: quickly scan a playlist, tell me which artists it flags, let me instantly block them without going through them one by one on Spotify, and even auto-skip AI songs when playing music.

sentences.en: But it does exactly what I need it to do: quickly scan a playlist, tell me which artists it flags, let me instantly block them without going through them one by one on Spotify, and even auto-skip AI songs when playing music.
sentences.zh: 但它正是我需要它做的：快速扫描播放列表，告诉我它标记了哪些艺术家，让我立即阻止他们，而无需在 Spotify 上一一浏览，甚至在播放音乐时自动跳过 AI 歌曲。

blocks.html_en: I can't tell you how many questionable recommendations I found in some of my playlists thanks to it. I easily weeded them out of my library.

sentences.en: I can't tell you how many questionable recommendations I found in some of my playlists thanks to it.
sentences.zh: 我无法告诉你我在一些播放列表中发现了多少有问题的推荐。

sentences.en: I easily weeded them out of my library.
sentences.zh: 我轻松地将它们从我的图书馆中剔除。

blocks.html_en: However, pay attention to the fact that both of these tools are not foolproof. They flagged some very real artists like HOKKA and Blas Canto as AI-generated. I've seen both of them sing live (Joel Hokka was a member of Blind Channel).

sentences.en: However, pay attention to the fact that both of these tools are not foolproof.
sentences.zh: 但是，请注意，这两种工具都不是万无一失的。

sentences.en: They flagged some very real artists like HOKKA and Blas Canto as AI-generated.
sentences.zh: 他们将 HOKKA 和 Blas Canto 等一些非常真实的艺术家标记为人工智能生成的。

sentences.en: I've seen both of them sing live (Joel Hokka was a member of Blind Channel).
sentences.zh: 我看过他们俩的现场演唱（Joel Hokka 是 Blind Channel 的成员）。

blocks.html_en: It's like playing whack-a-mole

sentences.en: It's like playing whack-a-mole
sentences.zh: 就像玩打地鼠一样

blocks.html_en: I've spent the past few weeks trying to remove as many AI artists and AI-generated music from my Spotify playlists and recommendations. The best way is to immediately tap Don't play this artist on any sketchy artist or band I spot.

sentences.en: I've spent the past few weeks trying to remove as many AI artists and AI-generated music from my Spotify playlists and recommendations.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几周里，我一直试图从我的 Spotify 播放列表和推荐中删除尽可能多的 AI 艺术家和 AI 生成的音乐。

sentences.en: The best way is to immediately tap Don't play this artist on any sketchy artist or band I spot.
sentences.zh: 最好的方法是立即点击“不要在我发现的任何粗略艺术家或乐队上播放该艺术家”。

blocks.html_en: But they keep popping up, more of them, all the time. Spotify has said it's working on labeling AI music, but artists will have to declare it themselves (ha!) and there's no toggle in the works to opt out of AI music by default. That sucks.

sentences.en: But they keep popping up, more of them, all the time.
sentences.zh: 但它们一直在不断出现，而且越来越多。

sentences.en: Spotify has said it's working on labeling AI music, but artists will have to declare it themselves (ha!)
sentences.zh: Spotify 表示正在努力为人工智能音乐贴上标签，但艺术家必须自己声明（哈！）

sentences.en: and there's no toggle in the works to opt out of AI music by default.
sentences.zh: 默认情况下，作品中没有选择退出人工智能音乐的开关。

sentences.en: That sucks.
sentences.zh: 太糟糕了。

blocks.html_en: Studies show that most people can't detect AI-generated music and that more than 28% of new music being published on Spotify is AI-generated or edited. It's a lucrative business that doesn't require much effort, so why would anyone stop doing it?

sentences.en: Studies show that most people can't detect AI-generated music and that more than 28% of new music being published on Spotify is AI-generated or edited.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，大多数人无法察觉人工智能生成的音乐，Spotify 上发布的新音乐中有超过 28% 是人工智能生成或编辑的。

sentences.en: It's a lucrative business that doesn't require much effort, so why would anyone stop doing it?
sentences.zh: 这是一项不需要太多努力、利润丰厚的生意，那么为什么有人会停止这样做呢？

blocks.html_en: Personally, I'd much rather my Premium money go to real artists, and until there's an easier way to do it, I'll continue fighting to fix my algorithm to only show me human-made music.

sentences.en: Personally, I'd much rather my Premium money go to real artists, and until there's an easier way to do it, I'll continue fighting to fix my algorithm to only show me human-made music.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，我更希望我的 Premium 资金流向真正的艺术家，并且在找到更简单的方法之前，我将继续努力修复我的算法，只向我展示人造音乐。

content_html_zh:
发布于 2026 年 7 月 31 日上午 7:30（美国东部时间）

Rita 是 Android Police 的高级作家。 她与 Android 的爱情故事始于 2010 年，并且随着每次更新、设备、提示、应用程序和游戏而变得更加深厚。 她是 Pixel 的忠实粉丝，花费了大量时间使用和测试 Google 的生态系统、应用程序和服务。

她住在法国，会说三种以上语言，关注皇家马德里，并利用任何空闲时间旅行。 曾几何时，她也是一名药剂师。

我自 2008 年以来一直是 Spotify 用户，首先作为免费听众，然后作为高级订阅者。 Spotify 的出色功能帮助我发现了许多我喜欢的艺术家和乐队，但最近，它已成为人工智能泛滥的垃圾箱。

当我第一次爱上人工智能艺术家时，我简直不敢相信。 对于我这个非专业人士的耳朵来说，它似乎太好了，与真正的艺术家的音乐没有什么区别。 如果人工智能仍然无法做出令人信服的图像，它怎么可能在音乐上欺骗我呢？

哦，我错了。 很快，我发现因为我听过一位艺术家的演奏，所以我的许多推荐同样都是人工智能生成的。 我的 Spotify 被毁了。 就在那时，我决定对此做点什么并阻止它。

Spotify 上假冒艺术家无处不在

你只需要注意

我在 Spotify 上听的音乐大约 90% 都是围绕我自己的播放列表或我信任的人创建的播放列表。 但每隔一段时间，我就会使用收音机或 Spotify 生成的混合播放列表，最终会出现在音乐流媒体算法方面。

这就是事情开始出错的地方。 有一天，我一边工作一边听音乐，享受音乐，但没有主动集中注意力。 很快，一个“艺术家”的名字出现了很多次，我停下来查看它们——“Apukat”。 每首歌都非常合我的口味。

他们的金属核、交响乐和现代竞技场摇滚氛围与我作为 Linkin Park、Muse、Apocalyptica、Nightwish、Within Temptation 等音乐迷所喜欢的音乐完美契合。这应该是我的第一个警告信号，它的公式化。

我花了一段时间才对这首音乐产生了粗略的感觉。 那时，我的 Spotify 已经被更多的人工智能艺术家超越了。 除了《Apukat》之外，我最心碎的两部作品是《Glum Aleks》和《Ministry of Dark》。 他们的音乐非常适合我的节奏。 下面列出了其他一些：

  • 流血的诗句
  • 幽灵//信号
  • 死亡时刻
  • 伊甸园的流放者
  • 阴影苏醒
  • 内心的恶魔
  • 黑曜石秋千
  • 艾文西斯
  • 天鹅绒日落
  • 超越蔑视
  • 流浪王
  • 妖术
  • 莱里克斯
  • 灵魂的呐喊
  • 除锈

这正是我在一些特定类型中遇到的情况。 我想象会有更多人工智能生成的艺术家和乐队从事流行、乡村、民谣、说唱、R&B、EDM、乡村或任何和所有音乐流派。 它不仅仅流行于摇滚乐和北欧金属。

实际上，让我们重新表述一下。 我没有遇到过这种音乐，Spotify 通过其广播、Discover Weekly、Daily Mixes 以及其他艺术家和流派的混合播放列表向我推荐了它。 它把音乐推给了我，没​​有任何警告说这都是人工智能生成的。

一些迹象表明您正在听的音乐是人工智能生成的

仔细听或睁开眼睛

正如我之前提到的，人工智能生成音乐的一些迹象就在音乐本身中：

  1. 歌声、口音和音色在歌曲之间会发生变化。
  2. 您可能会发现同一位声乐艺术家与不同的“乐队”一起演唱。
  3. 歌词是通用的，倾向于该流派的比喻，并且不要说任何太个人化或太出乎意料的内容。 它们是您能想到的最低公分母。
  4. 混音声音过于精致或充满伪影，尤其是乐器。
  5. 音乐太公式化，太适合这种类型。

但是，如果您像我一样不擅长检测音乐队列，那么还有其他迹象需要注意，任何精通互联网的人都应该能够检测到：

  1. 没有艺术家或乐队的照片，只有人工智能生成的通用且清晰的艺术家图像。
  2. 所有专辑和单曲封面也遵循相同的模式。
  3. Spotify 的简介非常模糊，没有提及任何人的名字。 他们中的大多数人都使用“项目”这个词。
  4. 歌曲的制作人员名单非常简单，没有列出任何真正的作曲家、制作人、作词家、乐器演奏者等。
  5. 他们于 2025 年开始出版音乐，一年内就推出了多张 EP 和专辑，非常多产。
  6. 他们的 YouTube 上充满了人工智能生成的视频或歌词视频。
  7. 他们没有任何社交媒体，也没有即将举行的巡演，也没有出现在 Songkick 或 Bandsintown 等音乐会跟踪网站上。

我用来从 Spotify 中剔除人工智能艺术家的两个工具

没有单一的切换，你必须完成工作

没有一种简单的方法可以告诉 Spotify 你不想听 AI 音乐。 相反，作为用户的你有责任弄清楚向你推荐的内容是由真正的艺术家还是由 Suno 或 Udio 等人工智能平台制作的。

当然，你可以自己进行调查，查看 Reddit 看看其他人的想法，查找 YouTube 上的评论，但我发现了两种更快的方法来做到这一点。

第一个是一个名为 Sloptracker 的网站（上面的屏幕截图），该网站由一位真正的音乐家创建，他希望提高人们对人工智能生成的 slop 对真正艺术家收入的影响的认识。

Sloptracker 拥有一个 AI 扫描仪，可以分析任何歌曲（Spotify URL 或 MP3 文件）的频谱和时序模式，以 99% 的准确度预测它是完全由 AI 生成、完全人造还是由 AI 处理。

根据我的经验，它的效果非常好，并帮助我验证了上面列出的艺术家是否也触发了危险信号。 它还列出了检测到的最热门的 AI 艺术家，因此您可以快速滚动浏览他们，看看是否有任何人引起您的注意。

例如，《Breaking Rust》迄今为止预计收入为 297,571 美元，每月有超过 2,000 名高级订阅用户流失。 如果这些订阅者花时间听人造音乐，那么这笔钱本来可以流向人类艺术家。

我发现的第二个工具是 Deezer 的 AI 音乐检测器，它可以从多个服务（Spotify、Apple Music、YouTube Music、SoundCloud、Tidal 等）扫描您的整个音乐库，并告诉您它标记的内容。

但导入和扫描工具对我来说一直失败，所以我找到了一个 Chrome 扩展程序，它使用 Deezer 的内置 AI 标签来逐个扫描我的播放列表。 它被称为 DigiMuziek AI Spotter，只有在您使用 Spotify 网站而不是 Windows 或 Mac 应用程序时才有效。

但它正是我需要它做的：快速扫描播放列表，告诉我它标记了哪些艺术家，让我立即阻止他们，而无需在 Spotify 上一一浏览，甚至在播放音乐时自动跳过 AI 歌曲。

我无法告诉你我在一些播放列表中发现了多少有问题的推荐。 我轻松地将它们从我的图书馆中剔除。

但是，请注意，这两种工具都不是万无一失的。 他们将 HOKKA 和 Blas Canto 等一些非常真实的艺术家标记为人工智能生成的。 我看过他们俩的现场演唱（Joel Hokka 是 Blind Channel 的成员）。

就像玩打地鼠一样

在过去的几周里，我一直试图从我的 Spotify 播放列表和推荐中删除尽可能多的 AI 艺术家和 AI 生成的音乐。 最好的方法是立即点击“不要在我发现的任何粗略艺术家或乐队上播放该艺术家”。

但它们一直在不断出现，而且越来越多。 Spotify 表示正在努力为人工智能音乐贴上标签，但艺术家必须自己声明（哈！） 默认情况下，作品中没有选择退出人工智能音乐的开关。 太糟糕了。

研究表明，大多数人无法察觉人工智能生成的音乐，Spotify 上发布的新音乐中有超过 28% 是人工智能生成或编辑的。 这是一项不需要太多努力、利润丰厚的生意，那么为什么有人会停止这样做呢？

就我个人而言，我更希望我的 Premium 资金流向真正的艺术家，并且在找到更简单的方法之前，我将继续努力修复我的算法，只向我展示人造音乐。
